title: quality_readiness-fail-loud-on-invisible-path data contracts
description: Additive fields introduced across the readiness family to make an invisible/nonexistent root distinguishable from a genuinely-empty folder. All additions are backward compatible (defaults preserve the prior shape for visible folders).

RootGuardResult.description: readiness_common.root_guard(folder) return tuple, expressed as an object. visible = Path(folder).exists(); warning is set iff not visible.

warning.description: 'Folder not found / not visible to the bodesign container: <root>' when not visible, else null

root_exists.description: False only when base.exists() is False; distinguishes invisible root from scanned-but-empty (root_exists=True, files=[])

ReadinessSignalAdditions.description: Additive keys present on EVERY readiness to_dict() (package + c00..c06). INV-4: for a visible folder root_visible=true and warnings=[], and all prior keys are unchanged (strict superset).

root_visible.description: False when the root is not visible to the container

warnings.description: Boundary explanation when root_visible is false; [] otherwise

ReadinessStatusSentinel.description: Where a readiness result carries a free-form status string (c04/c05/c06) the invisible-root sentinel is 'path-not-visible', distinct from the existing 'missing'/'blocked'/drafted vocabulary. c00 uses status 'path-not-visible' in its structured form (and still raises C00TemplateError for a missing answer_state.json inside a VISIBLE folder).
